# The Energy Nest

> Supportive guidance, guided meditation, and intention-setting
> sessions for software professionals. US-based, sessions delivered online.
> Complementary practices for relaxation and wellbeing - not medical care.

Status: pre-launch. Booking is not open; a waitlist is available.
All sessions are 60 minutes. Adults 18+ only.

## Services
- [Supportive Guidance](https://theenergynest.com/services/supportive-guidance/): reflective listening for work-related mental load
- [Meditate Together](https://theenergynest.com/services/meditate-together/): shared guided meditation
- [Set a Good Intention](https://theenergynest.com/services/set-good-intention/): weekly intention-setting ritual
- [Find Purpose Together](https://theenergynest.com/services/find-purpose-together/): in-person gathering, waitlist only

## Practical
- [Pricing](https://theenergynest.com/services/): $60 intro, $120 single, $400 four-pack, $200/mo membership, $40-60 supported rate
- [FAQ](https://theenergynest.com/faq/)
- [About](https://theenergynest.com/about/)
- [Contact](https://theenergynest.com/contact/): hello@theenergynest.com

## Scope
These are complementary wellbeing practices. They are not medical or
mental-health treatment, not a diagnosis, and not a substitute for
professional care. Crisis support in the US: call or text 988.
